visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is split horizontally. The top section displays two side-by-side gameplay footages from an isometric 2D RPG, showcasing characters battling monsters with explosive fire magic and numeric damage indicators. The lower section features a female performer with long black hair, dressed in a brown maid-style outfit and a white frilled headpiece, playing a white piano with high agility. A large purple plush character sits on the piano's edge. The room is softly lit with warm, indoor lighting, highlighting the fast-moving hand gestures on the piano keys. (2) The scene cuts to a full-screen cinematic 3D animation. A monumental white tower, encircled by floating pink crystals, ascends through fluffy white clouds into a blue sky dominated by a swirling celestial rift. A small, winged pink peach character with a halo flies gracefully through the air. Strategic text overlays and game logos materialize in the foreground, accompanied by mobile app store icons at the base of the frame, presented in a vivid and bright color palette.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with an energetic and melodic solo piano performance. The BPM is high, featuring rapid, clean keystrokes that create a bright and uplifting pop-ballad atmosphere. The recording is studio-grade with a high spectral centroid, focusing on the mid-to-high frequency clarity of the piano strings. No ambient noise or speech is present, maintaining a pure instrumental focus. (2) A subtle transition occurs where the solo piano is layered with synthesized cinematic orchestral elements. A female narrator's voice enters with a professional, warm, and mid-pitched delivery in Mandarin. This coincides with a shimmering Whoosh and Sparkle sound effect that emphasizes the visual magical tower. The harmonic tension remains low and positive, while the overall mix density increases as the music and vocals overlap to deliver the promotional slogan.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the game 'RO: Legend of Midgard - World Journey' by leveraging a skilled piano performance of its iconic music alongside internal beta gameplay footage to attract fans and new players.
